title: Finding FB2-REV-FND-000026: the independent monitor is justified by a 115 ms main-path figure that appears in no record; the safety goal's own allocation for that path sums to 85 ms

revision_history.author: quality_engineer
revision_history.description: Removed the stale 115 ms figure from FB2-SAF-FSR-000004 and FB2-HW-TSR-000004 (both revision 1 -> 2) and from FB2-ASM-008.rationale in both assumption registries, and restated the independent monitor's justification on the parameter-registry arithmetic. Corrected this finding's own evidence: 115 ms is traceable to FB2-REV-000001 embedded finding FB2-FND-000001 and is a superseded allocation, not an unsourced figure.

evidence: FB2-SAF-FSR-000004's rationale reads: 'addresses timing budget violation in main path (115 ms > 100 ms FTTI) by providing parallel safety channel'. FB2-HW-TSR-000004 repeats the same sentence word for word. No record in the corpus contains 115 ms. The nearest figure is FB2-SAF-SGO-000001's allocation, whose serial elements sum to 85 ms for the main path. 115 is neither 85 (the actual sum) nor 105 (the sum plus the recorded margin), so it cannot be reconstructed from the corpus at all.
impact: The justification for adding an independent ASIL B hardware channel - a substantial hardware cost and the basis of the ASIL D decomposition - rests on a number that cannot be located or reproduced. A reader checking the arithmetic finds nothing to check, and the most likely reading is that the figure was estimated at some point and never reconciled. The independent monitor may well be justified; the justification as written does not support it.
root_cause: The figure appears to predate the current allocation and to have survived a later rewrite of the timing budget without being updated. Two records carrying the identical sentence mean the figure has been copied rather than checked twice, so a single unverified number propagated to both the functional and the hardware level.
resolution: RESOLVED at source, and this finding's central piece of evidence is CORRECTED. The finding states that 115 ms 'cannot be reconstructed from the corpus at all'. It can. 115 ms is the sum of a SUPERSEDED allocation recorded in FB2-REV-000001, the as_is vertical-slice review, in its embedded finding FB2-FND-000001: 'FSR-001 specifies 10 Hz (100 ms); FSR-002 specifies 10 ms check; FSR-003 specifies 5 ms contactor; sum = 115 ms > FTTI 100 ms'. 100 + 10 + 5 = 115. The figure is therefore STALE, not fabricated, and it described an allocation the corpus has since replaced - FB2-PRM-000003 now gives afe_acquisition_period_ms = 50 and FB2-SAF-SGO-000001 allocates 25 ms for acquisition. That is a more precise root cause than 'the figure was estimated at some point and never reconciled', and it changes the remedy: the figure does not need reconstructing, it needs deleting. The 115 ms was removed from FB2-SAF-FSR-000004.rationale, from FB2-HW-TSR-000004.rationale, and from FB2-ASM-008.rationale in BOTH assumption registries (docs/artifacts/shared/assumption-registry.json and docs/artifacts/corpus/synthetic_reference/shared/assumption-registry.json) - a third and fourth occurrence the finding did not identify. The justification the 115 ms was carrying is now stated on figures that still hold and that are derived from the parameter registry: the main path is 85 ms of the 100 ms interval; at the 40 ms upper tolerance of FB2-PRM-000005 the contactor chain is 5 + 40 + 5 = 50 ms and the main path is 95 ms, leaving 5 ms; and if detection waits one full acquisition period of FB2-PRM-000003 (50 ms) rather than the 25 ms allocated, the main path is 85 - 25 + 50 = 110 ms and overruns the interval. A main-path-only reaction therefore has no tolerance for a degraded contactor or for one acquisition period, which is the substantive argument for a second barrier and does not need 115 ms at all. FB2-SAF-FSR-000004 and FB2-HW-TSR-000004 moved to revision 2 under this finding and under FB2-REV-FND-000027. The as_is records that hold the 115 ms were NOT edited: FB2-REV-000001 is origin source_observed and records the real project's review, and master prompt section 14 requires source contradictions to be preserved as gaps in as_is. No ASIL, safety_goal_ref, detection latency or threshold accuracy was changed. Human approval remains pending for every record named here: no human has confirmed this correction, no tool has been qualified, no certification is claimed and no ASPICE capability level is claimed. production_authorized stays false and product_verification_credit stays false on every record touched.
